slides.title: Search your run sheet for **"networking"**
slides.sub: Then ask three questions of every line you find.

items.title: Who is in the room?
items.text: If they can't find out before, they spend the break finding out.

items.title: What is the first line?
items.text: A prompt, a question, a reason. Borrowed words beat invented ones.

items.title: Where does it live?
items.text: "An app to install" means about a quarter of the room sees it.

slides.label: No answers?
slides.caption: A line with no answers is a coffee break. That's fine. Call it one.
slides.say: Just stop measuring it as networking.

slides.text: The coffee queue: the only networking format with 100% adoption.
slides.save: 💾 Save this for your next run sheet
